app.name: rolecard
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Upload your CV, add job offers and track your applications. Everything stays on this computer.
error.400.title: Request rejected
error.400.body: The request was not valid or did not come from this app. Reload the page and try again.
error.404.title: Page not found
error.413.title: File too large
error.413.body: The file is larger than 10 MB.
error.500.title: Something went wrong
error.500.body: An unexpected error happened. Your data was not changed.
form.has_errors: Some fields need fixing. Nothing was saved.
ai.working: Working… this can take a minute.
ai.error.not_installed: Claude Code is not installed or not on the PATH. Install it or choose another provider in Settings.
ai.error.not_configured: The AI service is not configured. Add its address and model in Settings.
ai.error.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again or raise the time limit in Settings.
ai.error.failed: The AI could not answer. Check that it works and that you are signed in.
ai.error.http: The AI service rejected the request. Check the address, model and key.
ai.error.network: Cannot reach the AI service. Check that it is running and the address is right.
ai.error.not_json: The AI answer was not in the expected format. Nothing was saved; try again.
ai.error.invalid: The AI answer did not pass validation. Nothing was saved; try again.
ai.error.insecure: The API key is only sent over https (or to this computer). Change the address in Settings to https://.
ai.error.quota: The AI service's usage limit is used up (on a free tier, usually a daily request limit). Nothing was retried; try again later.
ai.error.busy: The AI service is busy right now. Nothing was retried; try again in a few minutes.
ai.error.quota_wait: The AI service's usage limit is used up (on a free tier, usually a daily request limit). Nothing was retried; try again in {hours} h {minutes} min.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Saved in config.toml, inside your data folder.
settings.provider_help.auto: The OpenAI-compatible service if you have set it up (for example, Ollama); otherwise Claude Code if it is installed.
settings.provider_help.claude: Uses your Claude subscription, with no tools.
settings.provider_help.openai: Ollama, OpenAI or another service with the same API.
settings.provider_help.none: You fill in the profile by hand and offers stay unscored.
settings.key_hidden: Saved; never shown. Type a new one to change it.
settings.error.secret: The key cannot contain spaces or line breaks, nor be longer than 500 characters.
settings.key.none: Not set. Leave empty if your service needs none.
settings.key.config: Configured. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.key.env: Set by the ROLECARD_OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.
settings.timeout_help: How long to wait for each AI answer.
settings.test_help: The test uses the saved settings: save first.
settings.error.base_url: Write a full http:// or https:// address.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: The only source of facts used to score offers. The AI adds nothing that is not here.
profile.review_body: It was extracted from your CV by the AI. Fix anything that is wrong and press “Save profile”.
profile.upload_help: PDF or DOCX, up to 10 MB. The file is not kept, only its text.
profile.replace_confirm: Replace my current profile with this CV
profile.no_provider: No AI is configured: fill in your profile by hand, or set up the AI to read your CV.
profile.delete_confirm: Delete your profile? This cannot be undone.
profile.extracted: Your CV has been read. Review the profile below and save it.
profile.field.name: Name
profile.field.headline: Headline
profile.error.empty: Choose a file first: the one you sent was empty.
profile.error.too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. Your profile has not changed.
profile.error.type: Only PDF or DOCX files. Your profile has not changed.
profile.error.no_text: No text found in the file. It may be a scanned image: try the original PDF or a DOCX. Your profile has not changed.
profile.error.corrupt: The file could not be read (damaged or password-protected). Your profile has not changed.
profile.error.text_too_long: The CV has more than 50,000 characters of text, more than the AI reads at once. Shorten it or fill in the profile by hand. Your profile has not changed.
profile.error.confirm_replace: Tick the box to confirm that the new CV replaces your profile.
profile.error.no_provider: No AI is configured to read the CV. Set it up in Settings or fill in the profile by hand.
profile.error.email: Write a full email address, like name@example.com.
profile.error.too_long: Some text is too long or there are too many entries. Nothing was saved.
job.new.title: Add offer
job.new.intro: Paste the offer's text. When you save it we tell you how well it fits your profile.
job.new.wait: Scoring with the AI can take up to a minute.
job.field.url_help: Optional. Used for the “Open offer” button and to avoid saving it twice.
job.field.title: Role
job.field.title_help: If you leave it empty, the AI takes it from the text.
job.error.text_short: The text is too short to analyse: paste the whole offer.
job.error.text_long: The text is too long (50,000 characters at most).
job.error.url: Write a full http:// or https:// address.
job.error.url_taken: Another offer already has this link.
job.unscored.no_profile: Not scored: there is no profile to compare with yet.
job.unscored.no_provider: Not scored: no AI is configured.
job.unscored.retry: Not scored yet. You can try again.
job.delete_confirm: Delete this offer and its history? This cannot be undone.
tracking.title: Follow-up
tracking.error.notes: The notes are too long (10,000 characters at most).
board.title: Board
board.intro: Sorted by score within each status.
board.no_match_hint: Try another word or lower the minimum score.
empty.jobs.title: No offers yet
empty.jobs.text: Paste the text of an offer and the AI will score it against your profile.
dashboard.start.title: Get started in three steps
empty.provider.title: Set up the AI
empty.provider.text: rolecard uses the OpenAI-compatible service you set up, such as Ollama, or Claude Code if you have it installed.
empty.profile.title: Upload your CV
empty.profile.text: We extract your profile from the PDF or DOCX and you review it before it is used.
dashboard.week.title: This week
dashboard.follow_ups.title: Time to write again
document.regenerate_confirm: This replaces the current document and your changes. Continue?
document.intro: Every sentence shows the profile data it comes from. Review the highlighted ones before exporting.
document.profile_changed: Your profile has changed since this document was generated.
document.blocked.unresolved: Export is blocked: some sentences have no source. Edit, delete or confirm them.
document.blocked.not_reviewed: Export is blocked until you mark the document as reviewed.
document.reason.bad_path: a source is not in your profile
document.reason.offer_not_allowed: a CV sentence can only come from your profile
document.reason.number: it has a figure that is not in its sources
document.action.confirm: It is true, I take it
document.error.action: Write some text, or choose delete.
document.error.unresolved: Resolve the sentences without a source first.
job.documents.title: CV and cover letter
job.documents.needs: You need a profile and an AI provider to prepare documents.
document.substitutions: These characters cannot go in the PDF and will show as ?: {chars}
document.print.hint: Use your browser's Print and choose «Save as PDF».
document.reason.offer_only: it cites only the offer: check it says nothing about you that is not in your profile, and confirm it to export
document.reason.term: it names something (a name, an acronym or a technology) that is not in its sources: check it is true for you, and confirm it to export
document.blocked.structure_changed: Your profile's details (dates, roles, skills, education or languages) have changed. Generate the document again.
document.error.structure_changed: Your profile's details have changed: generate the document again.
document.blocked.offer_unconfirmed: Export is blocked: some sentences need your confirmation (they cite only the offer, or name something not in their sources). Confirm, edit or delete them.
document.error.offer_unconfirmed: Confirm the sentences marked to confirm first.
document.pending: Pending sentences: {count}. They are highlighted in the document and open in the side panel.
settings.sources_help: Public job APIs used by Searches. Only your search words are sent to them.
settings.source_key.file: Configured. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.error.sources: Check the sources form: unknown country or a key that is too long.
search.title: Search job sources
search.intro: Saved searches over public job APIs. New offers land on the board unscored.
search.field.name: Name
search.deleted: Search deleted. Its offers stay on the board.
search.delete_help: The offers it found stay on the board.
search.to_board: See the unscored ones on the board
search.error_code.bad_response: Sent an answer that could not be read
search.discard_confirm: Move the {count} unscored new offers of this search to discarded?
search.score_help: Up to 5 per click: each one is an AI request.
search.none_to_score: No offers of this search are waiting to be scored.
search.scored: Offers scored. If some are still unscored, click again.
search.error.name: Give it a name or some keywords.
search.field.required: Required words in the job title
search.field.excluded: Excluded words in the job title
search.help.query: Matches the job title only, not the description.
search.help.words: Comma-separated. Compared with the job title, ignoring case and accents.
search.help.location: Offers in another city are dropped, except remote ones with “Remote only”.
search.help.spain: Remotive and Arbeitnow are international: with a location in Spain they are not queried, unless “Remote only” is set.
search.status.remote_only: Not queried: every offer there is remote and remote is excluded
search.status.international: Not queried: international source and the location is in Spain
search.reason.title: {count} do not match the job title
search.reason.over_cap: {count} over the cap of 50 per source

bulk.label: With the ticked offers
bulk.scored: Ticked offers scored. If some are still unscored, click again.
bulk.none_to_score: None of the ticked offers is waiting for a score.

search.help.name: Optional: left empty, it becomes keywords · location.
profile.one_per_line_cited: One per line. Each line can be quoted in a CV.

settings.openai_only: only if you pick that option
settings.source_desc.adzuna: Spain and other countries; needs its keys
settings.ui_lead: They only change this interface, not the documents you generate.
